description:
Cast Summon: Knights of Round by paying {6}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying Summon: Knights of Round three times.
Resolve a copy of the Summon: Knights of Round spell, choosing to have it enter with five lore counters on it due to its read-ahead ability.
The Summon: Knights of Round token's fifth chapter ability triggers, causing creatures you control to get +2/+2 until end of turn and putting an indestructible counter on each of them, and then causing you to sacrifice the Summon: Knights of Round token.
Repeat from step 2.
